value.answer: I am writing to express my interest in the Senior Engineer, Core Banking role at Hollis Bank. With six years of backend engineering experience at Northwind Robotics, I owned a high-throughput order-routing service handling ~2M events/day using TypeScript, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. I also led a team of five at Vertex Logistics, overseeing dispatch and billing product lines. Notably, I led a nine-month strangler-fig migration of a monolith to event-driven services with zero customer-visible downtime, reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9s to 340ms. I am proficient in Kubernetes, Terraform, and PostgreSQL schema design and query tuning. I am eager to bring this experience to your core banking systems.
